overview: The Medford City Council met to receive an update on school department HVAC repairs and CARES Act funding, approved select Community Preservation Committee grant allocations, and considered license petitions and grant of location requests.

items.title: Common Victualler License - Medford Malden Elks #915
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license application for Scott Cullinane on behalf of the Medford Malden Elks Lodge #915.

items.title: Ordinance Amendment - Behavioral Health Commission
items.summary: Tabled a proposed ordinance establishing the Promote, Prevent, Support Behavioral Health Commission to allow the city solicitor to incorporate previously voted council amendments.

items.title: Special Permit Hearing - Luz Auto Works (134 Mystic Ave)
items.summary: Approved a special permit petition for Luis Rodriguez to operate Luz Auto Works as a Class 4 auto repair facility at 134 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Grant of Location Hearing - National Grid Gas Main on Riverside Ave
items.summary: Tabled National Grid's grant of location petition for gas main installation on Riverside Avenue until November 10 to obtain further details on project timing, curbing improvements, and utility coordination.

items.title: Update on School Department HVAC Funding and COVID-19 Operations
items.summary: Discussed an operational update from school and finance officials regarding allocated HVAC repair funding, building air quality testing, hybrid learning schedules, and federal CARES Act expenditures.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriations
items.summary: Approved CPC recommendations as amended, allocating $62,500 for emergency rental assistance through ABCD for Medford residents, $2,835 to restore the USMC KIA Markey Memorial, and $3,500 for an Oak Grove Cemetery tree inventory.

items.title: Resolution - Committee of the Whole on Zoning Consultant Contract Complaint
items.summary: Approved a resolution to hold a Committee of the Whole meeting to receive an administration update concerning a bid complaint filed regarding the council's zoning consultant contract.

items.title: Resolutions on Traffic and Pedestrian Safety
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting the installation of a flashing pedestrian crosswalk sign on Winthrop Street near Memorial Field and repairs to warning reflector beacons at railroad crossings on High Street and Canal Street.

items.title: Condolences and Commemorations
items.summary: Passed resolutions expressing condolences to the families of Regina 'Reggie' Reynolds and former crossing guard supervisor Lucille Tonello, and observed a moment of silence for George W. Hickey.

items.title: Infrastructure and Public Safety Maintenance Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting storm drain repairs at 48 Doonan Street, tree stump removals on Dawn Road, Doonan Street, and Lawrence Road, and replacement of a traffic island safety sign on High Street.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved committee reports from the Public Works Subcommittee regarding the snow shoveling ordinance and the Committee of the Whole regarding employee data disclosure and the gender equity ordinance.
